context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: Clarke’s Third Law concerns the gap between an observer’s understanding and the capabilities of unfamiliar technology. The publication trail includes a 1972 collection before the often-cited 1973 revised book; it is an imaginative rule of perspective, rather than a physical law proving supernatural claims.
